header.summary: Dragging the model triggers a candidate cross-topic bottleneck between Spatial Engine resource rebuild and one slow Binder dependency.

root_cause: Main-thread S share spikes during dragging; candidates center on spatial-engine resource rebuilding and one slow Binder call.

next_actions.action: Reduce spatial-engine resource rebuilding on the drag path
Capture the Binder caller stack in the same window to locate the blocking point

limitations: GPU counters are missing, so concurrent GPU saturation cannot be fully excluded
